proposition: The pages read frame Yazdī's relation to Ibn Turka two ways at once and do not reconcile them: as fellow disciple of Akhlāṭī (Gāzurgāhī) and as Ibn Turka's own disciple (Bākharzī reporting Jāmī; MK's 'chief disciple'); MK's own summary lists both as separate themes of the Herat image.

mediation.note: two later tazkiras with different aims
